svg.title: Zero, undefined and unknown are different cost states
svg.desc: Three fictional cases for the AI workflow cost ledger. Explicit zero in every cost category and one caller-accepted result gives zero unit cost. Total cost of one currency unit with no accepted results gives undefined unit cost, while the total cost remains one. A missing required cost causes an input error, not a zero-cost result. Include all failed attempts and retries; acceptance and costs are supplied by the caller.

g.text: AHMADREZA SAMADI · START WITH THE DECISION
Cost per caller-accepted AI result · Fictional teaching cases
Total cost includes all attempts, failures and retries.
Divide by distinct accepted result IDs—not the number of attempts.
Costs and acceptance labels are caller-recorded, not independently verified.
One currency label; no currency conversion. AI-assisted educational diagram.
